color.semantic_usage: Gold marks decisions and movement; teal carries trust and structure; status colors remain semantic.

typography.interface: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
typography.editorial_emphasis: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif italic

motion.reduced_motion: No line travel, entrance movement, smooth scrolling, or positional hover feedback

design_style.composition: asymmetric editorial sections and role-specific workspaces rather than repeated generic cards
design_style.imagery: owner-supplied night architecture/city image with layered teal treatment
design_style.trust_rule: Illustrative gold signals never imply readiness, approval, funding, or ledger confirmation

webgl.reason: The previous pavilion/3D-building direction is retired

svg_lines.behavior: Fine architectural paths with short traveling gold dash signals

image_treatment.behavior: Cover image, teal left/bottom overlays, restrained gold radial warmth, subtle grain
